note: Every new page, UI redesign, tool, or site-wide feature waiting for teacher review on staging MUST be listed here so it appears on /staging-review/#site before going live.

items.title: Renamed 'Lessons' + Synced Game Mode / Plain Mode Switch (Hide Breadventure Land)
items.summary: Renamed 'Cakebread Lessons' → 'Lessons' on the homepage with updated blurb ('Revision Notes for catch-up at home and Class Slides for the board'). Built a cross-device synced revision style preference (window.CBSMode, saved in localStorage['cbs.plain'] and Firestore users/{uid}.settings.plainMode) so students can hide Breadventure Land and default to plain Practice Questions anywhere: first-sign-in Year picker, a compact [⚔️ Game | 📝 Plain] switch beside Year 10 on Student Home, Upcoming Test Study Guides, an escape link on Missions (plus auto-redirect of ?subs= homework/guide links), Practice Questions, Flashcards Settings (hiding the XP/mana/loot bar and toasts while keeping IGCSE securing identical), and /how-to-use/#mode.
items.before: Only a local-only checkbox hidden at the bottom of Practice Questions redirected ?point=/?sub= links; Breadventure Land still appeared on Student Home, Study Guides, and Flashcards.
items.after: One account-synced Game / Plain mode toggle across onboarding, Student Home, Study Guides, Missions, Practice, Flashcards, and Help — hiding the game cleanly while keeping all IGCSE progress identical.

items.title: Homepage 'What's New' Box Removed + KS3/KS4 Filters Everywhere in Admin
items.summary: Removed the top-of-page 'What's new' banner from index.html (replaced /js/whats-new.js with a silent dismiss-once modal popup engine CBSAnnounce for future announcements). Added KS3 (Years 8–9) and KS4 (Years 10–11) filters alongside granular Year 8–11 across Admin Students, Spec Map, Teaching, All Set Work, Misconception Radar, and Study Guide builder. Auto-chained js/lesson-slides.js inside tools/spec/build_index.js so all future lessons wire into Misconception Radar automatically.
items.before: Inline What's New strip sat at the top of the homepage; Admin filters only showed single years or all.
items.after: Clean homepage with zero top strip; KS3, KS4 and Year 8–11 filters everywhere in Admin.

items.title: Admin Misconception & Reteach Radar → Exact Class Slide Jump
items.summary: New '🎯 Misconception Radar' view in Admin → Teaching (and linked from Overview) grouped by Year 8/9/10/11 or KS3/KS4 and time window (14d / 30d / All). Surfaces struggling spec points + over-confident tracker blind spots with one-click '🎬 Slide N' jumps straight to the exact projector slide, '⚡ Reteach 5-Q' board quizzes, and '📌 Set 2-day HW' prefill.
items.before: Overview only showed a flat all-time 'Hardest questions' list with no year filter or lesson slide link.
items.after: Year/KS-grouped reteach dashboard indexed to exact Class Slides (js/lesson-slides.js) for immediate classroom reteaching.

items.title: 🔥 Warm-Up (5-Question Covered-Topics Recall Starter)
items.summary: Added a '🔥 Warm-Up' button to the Class Slides projector toolbar and header (zero edits to existing slide decks). Opens 5 random easy Level-1 recall questions pulled across ANY previously covered topic for Year 8/9/10/11 (excluding the current lesson), with Year buttons and '↻ New 5'.
items.before: No one-click whole-class retrieval starter built into Class Slides.
items.after: One click from any Class Slides deck launches a 5-question cross-topic Warm-Up on the board.

items.title: Flashcards Family Quiz Mode & Study Guide 'At Home' Tip
items.summary: Added '👨‍👩‍👧 Family Quiz' on /Flashcards/ (10 large tap-to-reveal or printable cards with a 1-line parent instruction requiring zero GCSE science knowledge) plus a 2-line 'At home (for families)' key-words quizzing tip on /guide/ Study Guides.
items.before: No low-friction way for parents/carers to quiz students without knowing GCSE science.
items.after: One-tap 10-card Family Quiz + printable strip on Flashcards and a concise family cue on every Study Guide.

items.title: Post-Test DIRT Button, Worked Calc Steps, Tracker Touch/Blind-Spot Polish, Print Ergonomics & Streak Grace
items.summary: Added '🛠️ Fix your N missed points →' on /work/ test results (DIRT); 3-step worked Formula → Substitute → Answer card on L2/L3 calculation misses in Practice & Questing; larger mobile touch targets & unmistakable amber '⚠️ check' warning on Spec Trackers; upright .ps-spec & 1.32 line-height in print-sheet.css; side-by-side .ep-pair CSS ready for future calculation slides; and a 1-day streak grace + weekly count on Student Home.
items.before: Test results had no direct missed-points repair button; calculation misses showed one inline line; small tracker buttons and italic print spec lines.
items.after: Closed DIRT feedback loop, structured calculation working, BDA/WCAG-cleaner mobile trackers & print sheets, and kinder streak tracking.

items.title: Subject colour alignment (Chemistry red / Physics amber)
items.summary: Aligned Chemistry (#c8001e / #8c0013) and Physics (#d08000 / #8a5000) across the Homepage directory and Question Booklets so subject colours match Spec Trackers, Worksheets, and Revision Notes everywhere.
items.before: Homepage used amber for Chemistry and blue for Physics; Booklets used blue for Physics 6-Markers.
items.after: Biology = green, Chemistry = crimson red, Physics = amber gold consistently across all hubs.

items.title: Teacher & Family Research Page (/research/)
items.summary: Explains the cognitive science, UK classroom pedagogy (EEF, Mr Barton, TeacherToolkit, CogSciSci), web/print clarity (Caviglioli, NN/g, GOV.UK, BDA), game motivation (SDT, Sailer & Homner), and family learning routines behind Cakebread Science, with verified external links.
items.before: No teacher- or family-facing explanation page existed on the site.
items.after: Public (no sign-in, noindex while in review) page linked from Admin → Site → Research, including a shareable #families guide.

items.title: Curious-Student Science of Learning Page (/how-to-use/science-of-learning.html)
items.summary: Plain-English deep dive for curious Years 8–11 students covering Illusion of Competence, Desirable Difficulties, 2-day spacing, interleaving, Questing psychology, and 5-minute family quizzing.
items.before: No deeper student-facing memory science page existed.
items.after: Subtly linked at the bottom of /how-to-use/ (not pushed in headers, tours, or Student Home).

items.title: Student Home v2 (/today/): Unified 2-Column To Do, Breadventure Banner & Full-Width IGCSE Progress
items.summary: Merged 'From your teacher' and 'Suggested for you' into one crisp 2-column To Do hub (replacing tiny emoji rows with clean 'Practise →' cards), added the full-width Cakebread Questing / Breadventure Land pixel-art banner with live moves & level right beneath it, expanded 'Your IGCSE progress' + 'Covered in class' across the full page width, and upgraded the Explore dock to site monoline SVG icons.
items.before: Half-width cramped progress/covered box, tiny unreadable icons on target rows, no Breadventure banner.
items.after: Vibrant, balanced Student Home matching the homepage look, with full-width IGCSE progress & Covered in class.

items.title: Student Guide (/how-to-use/) & Spotlight Guided Tours (/js/tour.js)
items.summary: Brief student-facing tutorial page (linked via ❓ Guide in headers) plus first-visit dimmed spotlight + directional-arrow tours across key student pages (never shown on /admin/ or Class Slides).
items.before: No guided onboarding or student tutorial page.
items.after: One-time per-page Spotlight tours with a reminder pointing to ❓ Guide + replay links.

items.title: 2-Day Spaced Homework Default & Live Homework Progress Bar
items.summary: Admin → Teaching now defaults to 2-day spaced missions (10 Qs × 2 different days). Practice & Questing track ?hw=<id> live with a progress bar and clear Continue / Day-1-done / Homework-complete end banners.
items.before: Homework defaulted to 20 right in one sitting; Practice/Questing didn't know when a mission was part of homework.
items.after: Research-backed 2-day spaced missions with unmistakable completion feedback and automatic next-day badge wakeup.

items.title: Staging-Only Year 10 Student Simulator (/js/staging-sim.js)
items.summary: Top-bar '🧑‍🎓 Simulate Y10 student' button (strictly disabled on live cakebreadscience.com and /admin/) that previews Alex Ten (Year 10) with rich homework, tests, 30 covered sub-topics, 14 due flashcards, and tours in an isolated localStorage sandbox.
items.before: Testing student flows on staging required signing in as a separate student account.
items.after: One click launches a full sandboxed Y10 student with Replay tour, Reset demo, and Exit sim controls.

items.title: Admin Outstanding Homework View & Inactive Account Cleanup
items.summary: Added Outstanding Homework summary cards in Admin → Teaching, sortable Homework column + Outstanding filter + inactive account cleanup in Admin → Students, and per-student outstanding homework + Remove account in the Student drawer.
items.before: Hard to see overdue homework across a year group or clean up unused student accounts.
items.after: At-a-glance overdue badges, student filtering, and safe non-admin data deletion.
